name: Oat Rice
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Wash the rice and drain the water.
Pour the oat milk and rice into a pot.
Put the pot on the stove, and cook over medium heat for about 5 minutes or until foam appears.
Start stirring the mixture with a spoon, and continue stirring until the mixture boils.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, stirring, until almost all the liquid is gone.
Remove from the heat and serve.
